description: A box towed at 1 m/s through the free surface (X 11 2 0 0 0 0 0, X 210 1 0 0) with the refinement zone along its motion and a wake wedge (G 12 0.08, G 13 0.3 19.47: margin 0.08 m, wedge of half angle 19.47 deg and length 0.3 m at most, only where the bow has been), regrid every 2 steps: the zone reaches ahead by the distance travelled until the next regrid, the lazy layout rebuilds the patches only when the zone has moved on.
covers: cfd_amr::zone_seed (heading, ahead margin, wake wedge from the start of the body)
